task: Retrospective CLIP-only diagnostics on explicitly unsuitable UI images

promptProtocol.method: imageClipPrompts(meaning) with default options; no generated scene prompts, no extraQueries, no other definitions/contrasts.
promptProtocol.unwantedPrompt: Text, a logo, a diagram, a screenshot or a document.
promptProtocol.sceneSource: Source AI scenes/scene metadata were unavailable in training-examples.json; no scene text was invented. With no scene or alternatives, imageClipPrompts emits selected target plus unwanted prompt; semanticScores selected=raw target cosine and margin=0.

exactNoContrastAutoSelectGate.summary: Gallery-level diagnostic using available pixel-ready consensus examples only; screenshot-only and uncertain candidates were deliberately excluded, so this does not replay the full chooser.

thresholdGrid.selectionRule: On validation only, for each false-positive-rate cap choose the highest positive recall among grid thresholds satisfying selected >= t AND unwanted < .20; ties choose the larger threshold. Test set is evaluated once per frozen operating point.
thresholdGrid.promotion: Research candidate only; do not promote before fresh provider-specific Pexels UI data. Personalizer/MLP cannot override a failed CLIP eligibility gate.

limitations: Small imbalanced UI pilot: only 5 pixel-ready positive images and 81 negative images across meaning groups.
Retrospective diagnostic, not an independent test; threshold and prompt choices were not prospectively frozen for this pilot.
Threshold metrics are per-image and can overstate evidence because images cluster within meanings; cluster bootstrap is included but remains unstable with few positive groups.
The evaluated app ranking score is the exact semanticScores formula with current prompt configuration and no personalizer contribution; it is not a calibrated probability.
Current app auto-selection also compares all gallery candidates and requires a score gap; the per-image threshold confusion matrix is not equivalent to gallery-level safe auto-selection.
No user settings, installed application, keys, study statistics, or personal data were accessed.

reproducibility.localModelCache: work/image-pretraining/cache/models (read through symlink; local_files_only enabled; no downloads)
